dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。差し支えなければ、性別と年齢を教えて頂いても大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. If you don't mind, could you please tell me your gender and age?

dialogue.content: 46歳男性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 46-year-old man.

dialogue.content: お答えいただきありがとうございます。今日はどのような相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 仕事が辛くて会社を辞めたいんですが転職の当てもなくて
dialogue.English: My job is so stressful that I want to quit, but I don't have any job prospects.

dialogue.content: それは心配ですね
dialogue.English: That must be worrying.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんな状況かお話頂いてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Could you please tell me more about your situation?

dialogue.content: 上司がとても厳しい人で叱咤が激しいというか
dialogue.English: My boss is a very strict person, and his scolding is intense, or rather... harsh.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: しょっちゅう怒鳴り散らされています
dialogue.English: I'm constantly being yelled at.

dialogue.content: 大手の転職斡旋会社に相談に行ったこともあるのですが、今までやってきた仕事が特殊なので、
dialogue.English: I've gone to a major job placement agency for a consultation, but because the work I've done so far is specialized,

dialogue.content: キャリアを活かした仕事を斡旋してもらえません全然違った仕事ばかり紹介されてほんとガッカリしました
dialogue.English: they couldn't place me in roles that make use of my career experience. They only introduced completely different kinds of jobs, and I was really disappointed.

dialogue.content: 妻子を抱えてこの年でキャリアの無い仕事というのも不安です
dialogue.English: With a wife and child to support, the thought of taking a job at my age without a relevant career path is unsettling.

dialogue.content: 不安な気持ちでいたたまれないですね
dialogue.English: It must be unbearable to feel so anxious.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: （すみません　送信エラーで遅くなりました
dialogue.English: (I’m sorry—a transmission error caused a delay.

dialogue.content: 今の仕事はどのくらい続けていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been at your current job?

dialogue.content: かれこれ20年くらいです
dialogue.English: For about 20 years now.

dialogue.content: あ、16年です
dialogue.English: Oh, actually 16 years.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・そんなに長く続けてらしたのに・・
dialogue.English: I see... After you've been there for so long...

dialogue.content: 上司の方が厳しいのはいつ頃からなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Since when has your boss been so strict?

dialogue.content: 最初からですねでも自分の年齢が上がってくるとだんだん辛さが増してきました
dialogue.English: From the very beginning. But as I've gotten older, it's become harder and harder to bear.

dialogue.content: 転職を考えてるほど、お辛いんですね・・
dialogue.English: It must be so difficult that you're considering changing jobs...

dialogue.content: 辛いし、苦しいです
dialogue.English: It’s painful and distressing.

dialogue.content: その人ちょっと躁鬱の気がある人で
dialogue.English: That person seems to have some bipolar tendencies.

dialogue.content: 躁のときは、エキセントリックというかほんとうに激しいんです
dialogue.English: When he’s in a manic state, he can be eccentric, or rather, just really intense.

dialogue.content: 入社した時からずっと同じ上司の方なんですねそんなに長く怒鳴られたりしているなんて・・本当に苦しくていやになりますね・・
dialogue.English: So you've had the same boss since you joined the company. Being yelled at for so long... that must be truly painful and demoralizing.

dialogue.content: 感情の波があるんですね
dialogue.English: So he has emotional ups and downs.

dialogue.content: はいでも悪気ではなくてわたしのことを期待するあまりの叱咤だということはわかるんですが
dialogue.English: Yes, but I know it's not out of malice. I understand that his harsh reprimands are a result of his high expectations for me.

dialogue.content: そんなに長くよく今まで耐えていらっしゃいましたね・・
dialogue.English: It's amazing you've endured it for so long...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 悪気はないのですね
dialogue.English: So there's no malice.

dialogue.content: お前はこんな程度の人間じゃないはずだこんなの仕事じゃないって感じで
dialogue.English: He says things like, “You’re better than this. This isn’t the quality of work I expect from you.”

dialogue.content: 私だっていい仕事をしたいですよ
dialogue.English: I want to do good work, too.

dialogue.content: そんなひどいことを・・・
dialogue.English: That's a terrible thing to say...

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: Of course.

dialogue.content: 私の仕事は研究なんですが、それだけをやっていればいいというものではなくて
dialogue.English: My job is research, but it’s not like I can just focus on that and nothing else.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってお仕事されているのに否定されたら、本当に辛いですね・・
dialogue.English: When you're working so hard only to have your efforts dismissed like that, it must be truly painful.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: ルーチンワークを沢山やりながら、研究もできるという感じなんです
dialogue.English: It's more like I do research while also handling a lot of routine work.

dialogue.content: なので、研究だけをやっている機関の人に負けないようないい研究ってなかなかできないんです
dialogue.English: So, it's hard to do high-quality research that can compete with people in institutions that focus solely on research.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: その人はとても優秀な研究者なので、私のそんな言い訳を赦してはくれずにもっといい研究が出来るはずだと
dialogue.English: He is a very brilliant researcher, so he doesn’t accept those kinds of “excuses” from me and insists I should be able to do better research.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私だっていい研究そしたいんですでも他の仕事が忙しくてしんどいんです
dialogue.English: I want to do good research too, but I'm exhausted from being so busy with other tasks.

dialogue.content: わかってもれえずに、一方的に怒鳴られて・・理不尽な気持ちなりますね
dialogue.English: To be yelled at one-sidedly without being understood... it must feel so unfair.

dialogue.content: 理不尽もあるんですが
dialogue.English: There's the unfairness, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 私自身がもっといい研究をしたいと思っているからよけいに辛いんです
dialogue.English: It's even more painful because I myself want to do better research.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・そうなんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see... so that's how it is...

dialogue.content: だからいっそのこと研究のできない仕事を探そうかと思ったのですが
dialogue.English: That's why I even thought about looking for a job where I couldn't do research at all.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今までのキャリアを活かせそうな仕事は紹介してもらえなかったんです
dialogue.English: But they couldn’t introduce me to any jobs where I could make use of my career so far.

dialogue.content: 研究業績も十分でないので、研究だけをやれる職なんて、夢のまた夢ですし
dialogue.English: And since my research achievements aren’t strong enough, a position where I could only do research is just a pipe dream.

dialogue.content: そんなにも悩まれて、転職先を探そうかと思われていたのですね
dialogue.English: You’ve been struggling so much that you were even considering looking for a new job.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 職場のどなたかに相談されたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked with anyone at your workplace about this?

dialogue.content: 余り話してないですね
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: 専門分野が狭いので、他の部署に異動も難しいし
dialogue.English: My field of expertise is so specialized that it's difficult to transfer to another department.

dialogue.content: 上司の性格は説得して治るような感じはしないですから
dialogue.English: And his personality doesn't seem like something that would change just by talking to him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 相談してほかの部署に移るとかは難しい専門的なお仕事なんですね
dialogue.English: So it's such a specialized job that it's difficult to transfer to another department, even if you were to discuss it with someone.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: あなたの悩んでいるお気持ち、辛いお気持ちをわかってくれそうな方は、身近にいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone close to you who might understand your worries and how much you're suffering?

dialogue.content: 友人には愚痴をこぼすことがありますけど、
dialogue.English: I sometimes vent to my friends, but...

dialogue.content: 結局どうにもならないしね
dialogue.English: in the end, it doesn't solve anything.

dialogue.content: おひとりで抱え込んでいては、本当に苦しいし辛いですよね・・
dialogue.English: It must be truly painful and difficult to carry this all by yourself...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 愚痴を聞いてくださる方はいるのですね
dialogue.English: So there are people who will listen to you vent.

dialogue.content: たまにですけど
dialogue.English: Occasionally.

dialogue.content: でも、あなたはこの現状をどうにかしたいと思っているのですね
dialogue.English: But you want to do something about your current situation, don't you?

dialogue.content: この苦しみを何とかならないかと思いますが
dialogue.English: I wonder if there's any way to alleviate this suffering,

dialogue.content: でも、やっぱり研究は続けたいのかもしれませんちょっと混乱していて済みません
dialogue.English: But... I think I might want to continue my research after all. I'm sorry, I'm a bit confused.

dialogue.content: ここまでのお話を整理させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お時間いただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you give me a moment?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: Of course.

dialogue.content: あなたは、今の仕事を16年も頑張って研究を続けてこられてきましたが、今は仕事が辞めたいほど辛い気持ちになっています
dialogue.English: You've been working hard and continuing your research at your current job for 16 years, but right now you're feeling so distressed that you want to quit.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いい研究がしたいのに、上司は厳しい人であなたの研究を認めてくれずに、あなたの仕事はこの程度のものではない、もっとできるはずと、怒鳴ったりもすることもあり、あなたはとても苦しくて辛い思いをしています
dialogue.English: Even though you want to do good research, your boss is strict and doesn't acknowledge your work. He sometimes yells, saying things like, 'Your work shouldn't be at this level, you can do better,' and this is causing you a great deal of pain and suffering.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: ほんとうは、いい研究がしたいのに自分の仕事だけしていればいいわけではなく、ほかの仕事も忙しくて
dialogue.English: The truth is, you want to do good research, but it's not a job where you can focus solely on that, and you're also busy with other tasks.

dialogue.content: ほんとうはいい研究がしたいのに、ほかのしごとが忙しくて
dialogue.English: You truly want to do good research, but other work keeps you busy,

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's exactly it.

dialogue.content: できないと、あなたは自分に言い訳している気持ちもあり、上司にはそのことをわかって欲しいと思っています
dialogue.English: and when you can't, you feel like you're just making excuses to yourself, while also wishing your boss would understand your situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いっそのこと、研究ではない仕事先の転職も考えたのですが、これまでのキャリアに見合うような仕事は紹介してもらえず
dialogue.English: You even considered changing to a job that isn't in research, but you weren't introduced to any positions that matched your career history.

dialogue.content: この先どうしていったらよいのか、ますます悩んでいらっしゃる。これであってますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: And so you're increasingly worried about what to do from here. Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.content: 概ねそういうことだと思います
dialogue.English: I think that's generally it.

dialogue.content: 先ほどご自分で答えを見つけられたように、本当は研究職が好きで続けたいお気持ちがあるのですよね？
dialogue.English: As you seemed to realize yourself a moment ago, the truth is you love research and want to continue, don't you?

dialogue.content: 本当はそうなんですよねあまりのつらさにドロップアウトしたくなったけれど、せっかく研究の道に進んだんですから
dialogue.English: That's true. The pain made me want to drop out, but I've come so far on this path of research.

dialogue.content: 研究職以外の仕事はできたら最小限にして、研究に没頭うできたら、と思っていらっしゃるのでは？と今までのお話を伺って、思いました。
dialogue.English: Listening to you, it seems to me that you wish you could minimize the non-research work and immerse yourself in your research, if possible.

dialogue.content: それができたら一番いいのですがそうはいかないことになっているのです
dialogue.English: That would be ideal, but things just aren't set up that way.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・だから苦しくて悩んでいらっしゃるですよね
dialogue.English: Right... and that’s why you’re in so much pain and feeling so conflicted.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご自分の理想と現実のギャップになんとかならないだろうか・・と
dialogue.English: You’re wondering if there’s any way to bridge the gap between your ideals and reality.

dialogue.content: それは大きいですね
dialogue.English: That's a big part of it.

dialogue.content: あなたは、ご自分がなりたい理想とか目標をしっかりと持っている方なので、よけいに苦しいんだろう・・と思いました
dialogue.English: I imagine that because you have such clear ideals and goals for yourself, it's all the more painful.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: 自分の理想が強い上に、さらに上司の理想がもっと強い
dialogue.English: On top of my own high ideals, my boss's ideals are even higher.

dialogue.content: その上に上司の方も、あなたに期待するあまり、厳しいのですね
dialogue.English: And on top of that, your boss is strict because he has such high expectations of you.

dialogue.content: でも、その上司とはいつも言い合っている訳ではなくて、研究のことを暑く語り合うこともあるんです
dialogue.English: But it's not like we're always arguing. There are times when we talk passionately about research, too.

dialogue.content: 研究者としては尊敬しているのですが...
dialogue.English: I respect him as a researcher, but...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 偉すぎる上司を持つと苦労するんです
dialogue.English: It's tough having a boss who's too brilliant.

dialogue.content: やっぱり会社を辞めることはできないような気がします
dialogue.English: I'm starting to feel like I can't quit the company after all.

dialogue.content: そう思われるのですね
dialogue.English: Is that what you're feeling now?

dialogue.content: そう思われるのですね
dialogue.English: Is that what you're feeling now?

dialogue.content: はいつらくても研究を諦めたくはないのかもしれません
dialogue.English: Yes... even if it's painful, I might not want to give up on research.

dialogue.content: 今話していてそんな感じがしてきました
dialogue.English: I'm starting to feel that way as we're talking.

dialogue.content: あなたは本当は心の底では、研究がとてもしたいことはわかっているけれど、偉すぎる上司の期待に応えることが苦しくて悩まれていたのかも？と思いました
dialogue.English: I was thinking that perhaps, deep down, you know you really want to do research, but you've been suffering because it's so painful to meet the expectations of your brilliant boss.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: やっぱり研究が好きなんですね
dialogue.English: I really do love research, don't I?

dialogue.content: きっと誠実で真面目なあなたなら、こつこつと頑張っていけば成果がきっとでてくるのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: For someone as sincere and diligent as you, I'm sure that if you keep working at it steadily, you'll see results.

dialogue.content: それは運次第というところもありますね
dialogue.English: There's an element of luck involved, though.

dialogue.content: いえ、運は自分の努力や頑張りが引き寄せるものですから。
dialogue.English: No, luck is something that you attract with your own effort and hard work.

dialogue.content: そうなればいいですけど
dialogue.English: I hope so.

dialogue.content: 研究が好きでとことん頑張っていけば、きっと良い方向にいかれると思います
dialogue.English: If you love research and give it your all, I'm sure things will go in a good direction.

dialogue.content: 今の苦しい悩みは、これから自分の生き方のヒントになるのかもしれません
dialogue.English: This painful struggle you're facing now might become a hint for how to live your life from here on out.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね
dialogue.English: I wonder if that's true.

dialogue.content: 上司から１６年間も厳しいことを言われ続けてきても、投げ出さずに頑張ってこれたのですから
dialogue.English: After all, you've managed to keep going for 16 years without giving up, despite the harsh things your boss has said.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってきた自分をほめてあげましょう
dialogue.English: You should give yourself credit for all the hard work you've done.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 自分でもよく我慢してきたとは思います
dialogue.English: I do think I've put up with a lot.

dialogue.content: あなたは、尊敬に値する立派な研究者を上司にもって、恵まれていると思います
dialogue.English: I think you're fortunate to have such a respectable and admirable researcher as your boss.

dialogue.content: それも、あなたが引き寄せた運ではないでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Isn't that also the luck that you attracted?

dialogue.content: あなたは、もっと価値がある人です
dialogue.English: You have more value than you think.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね
dialogue.English: Do you really think so?

dialogue.content: この苦しい現状を乗り越えたら、どんな未来がまっているのかもう一人の自分に言ってあげるとしたら、どんな言葉をかけるでしょうか
dialogue.English: If you were to tell another version of yourself what kind of future awaits after overcoming this difficult situation, what words would you use?

dialogue.content: そんなふうに考えてみいるのもいいかもしれません
dialogue.English: It might be good to try thinking about it that way.

dialogue.content: すぐには言葉が浮かびませんが、考えてみます
dialogue.English: Nothing comes to mind right away, but I'll think about it.

dialogue.content: 辞めることができないなら、前向きに頑張るしかないですからね
dialogue.English: If I can't quit, then I have no choice but to try to be positive and do my best.

dialogue.content: ずっと苦しさにも耐えて頑張ってこられた、あなたならきっと前向きになれると信じています
dialogue.English: I believe that someone like you, who has endured so much hardship and worked so hard for so long, can definitely find a way to be positive.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 上司もいつか認めて下さると思います
dialogue.English: I believe your boss will give you the recognition you deserve someday.

dialogue.content: いつの日かそうなるといいなと思います
dialogue.English: I hope that day comes.

dialogue.content: はい、そんな日が来ますように応援していますね
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll be rooting for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日のご相談は大丈夫そうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel okay about our session for today?

dialogue.content: はい話してみて頭の整理ができました
dialogue.English: Yes, talking it through has helped me organize my thoughts.

dialogue.content: それは、良かったです！
dialogue.English: I'm so glad to hear that!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい、では今日はこれで終了にさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Alright, then we'll end our session for today.

dialogue.content: はいありがとぅございました
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、お話頂いてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for sharing your story with me.

dialogue.content: （スナフキンさま、今日は私の不手際で開始時間が大変遅くなりご迷惑をお掛けしました。申し訳ございません。途中も送信エラーが続き、返信に時間がかかり本当に申し訳ありません
dialogue.English: (Snufkin-sama, I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience today. Due to my error, our start time was significantly delayed. I am also very sorry for the repeated transmission errors during our session, which delayed my replies.

dialogue.content: では終了ボタン押させていただきますね）
dialogue.English: I'll press the end button now.)

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですよ私も結構おっちょこちょいなので
dialogue.English: It’s alright. I can be pretty scatterbrained myself.

dialogue.content: はい、修了して下さい
dialogue.English: Yes, please end the session.
